body:
Starship is moving away from using nerd font symbols by default:

```suggestion
            symbol: "🅵  ",
```

```suggestion
            symbol: "F ",
```

Actually, the output on Debian with package `flang-19` is:
```
Debian flang-new version 19.1.4 (1~deb12u1)
Target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /usr/lib/llvm-19/bin
```
On macOS (Homebrew package `flang`), it is:
```
Homebrew flang version 20.1.4
Target: arm64-apple-darwin24.3.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /opt/homebrew/Cellar/flang/20.1.4/libexec
Configuration file: /opt/homebrew/Cellar/flang/20.1.4/libexec/flang.cfg
Configuration file: /opt/homebrew/etc/clang/arm64-apple-darwin24.cfg
```

I didn't find an official package for Arch, so couldn't test it there.

So, regarding macOS, you're absolutely right - but I think that, at least, Debian based systems wouldn't be supported with that change.
`flang` should match both `flang-new` and `flang`, but keeping should be fine because there is no functional difference.
